info.name: Godine - Restaurant Queue API
info.description:
Single collection — Auth, Admin, Restaurant, Manager, Customer.

Includes: wait-time (2 category + per-user ETA), fixed time-slot scheduling, cron batch notifications, admin customer create with password.

Note: Restaurant create/update = faktu form-data (logo) wala. Admin table add (POST /admin/tables) removed — admin table manage nathi kare.
